text.description_html:
Don-Jo 2.5 x 7 Push Plate

Custom size 2.5" x 7" brushed stainless steel commercial door push plate. Primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories and stores. Made in the USA from .050" thick solid steel. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 2.5 x 7 Push Plate:

  • Plate Height: 7"
  • Plate Width: 2.5"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with Mounting Screws.
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel

*Sold Individually
